faqs.question: What is a normal adult weight range for a Boxer?
faqs.answer: This breed record lists 50-80 lb (23-36 kg). Your veterinarian sets the target for the individual using body condition, not only the breed average.

faqs.question: Which health issues should I watch for in a adult Boxer?
faqs.answer: This stage guide highlights Cancer risk (breed-associated); Cardiomyopathy / arrhythmia screening; Hip dysplasia. Use the linked symptom pages for red flags, then contact your clinic.

faqs.answer: Every 30 days is a practical adult Boxer default unless your veterinarian sets a tighter plan.
